assistanceEvents.informationUsed: Compared pgsodium invalid-key/aarch64 startup symptoms. The eventual root cause was independently established as Colima not mounting macOS /private/tmp.
Classify as a builder evidence-redaction failure, contain the disposable target, preserve the frozen window, and run a fresh r2 untimed remediation extension.

failures.detail: macOS date did not support the requested fractional format; seconds-resolution timestamp retained.
Colima could not mount the /private/tmp Git worktree. Docker treated pgsodium_root.key as a directory and Postgres failed health checks.
The zsh wrapper assigned to readonly variable status after the provider command failed.
A one-level-too-deep CLI workdir briefly used collision-prone default Compose identity supabase; preflight proved no owner and it was immediately retired.
Correcting the key's type exposed permission and additional Kong certificate/Edge entrypoint binds. Replaced with a disposable Docker-facing mirror under /Users.
Explicit table grants were missing; added authenticated/service-role grants while retaining RLS.
A UUID server filter was rejected, and CDC readiness was inconsistent after db reset. Explicit Realtime auth fixed the privilege cause; the app adopted Supabase's recommended private Broadcast path.
The running Edge manifest predated the function file. An exact scoped restart with backup reloaded it and preserved data.
The CLI emitted generated local credentials as one-line JSON and a builder redaction expression failed. Original target contained and retired; see the incident receipt.
A permission-denied response was initially treated as a leak instead of successful denial; assertion corrected.
Auth principals survived a db reset; deterministic setup now removes only the three exact actor emails before recreating them.
